# Tradr

> Free browser trading game — 3-minute races vs algorithmic bots on live candlestick charts.

## Official links

- Play: https://tradr.it.com/
- Multiplayer: https://tradr.it.com/multiplayer
- Community gallery: https://tradr.it.com/community
- Sitemap: https://tradr.it.com/sitemap.xml

## What is Tradr?

Tradr (tradr.it.com) is a free web trading game for practice and competition—not real-money trading or financial advice. You trade on a TradingView-style chart while algorithmic bots (RSI scalping, EMA trend, Darvas-style breakouts) trade the same market. Rounds last three minutes; highest return wins.

## Modes

- **Solo**: Random or historical markets (forex, gold, stocks, crypto daily data).
- **Multiplayer**: Shared seeded rooms; lobby lists open rooms with traders waiting.
- **Community gallery**: Anonymous run replays; **Play alongside** lets you trade live while a recorded session replays as a "Peer trader" bot.

## Tech

Next.js, TypeScript, canvas chart, Supabase Realtime + Postgres for multiplayer and gallery.

## Keywords
